scope: Revalidación y mejora de la tira actual de FFmpeg

method.clip: H.264 1920x1080 30 fps, 12 seconds, 20 midpoints, JPEG height 64, q:v 10, decoder threads 2/filter threads 1
method.runs: Three fresh Electron processes per variant, isolated userData, real production pool and FFmpeg; original extractor backed up before changes
method.timing: Native backend first callback/final promise; renderer checked separately via production preload, handlers, hook and LogoTimeline in a hidden diagnostic component fixture
limitations: Variable machine load and only 70–724 MiB free RAM at backend starts; no throughput or aggregate CPU/RSS improvement claim
Renderer fixture hidden with diagnostic CSS; decoding/DOM evidence is not visible paint, 60 fps, INP or full editor/installer certification
First native UI run overlapped full tests; rAF gaps are not valid comparative smoothness evidence
Cancellation fields for before-1 used phase labels incorrectly; retained raw processes identify abandoned input by filename; post-cancel count comparisons use runs 2 and 3
